verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout: the TRY NOW starburst floats loose in the upper middle, isn't aligned with the headline's left edge, and is cut off from the copy, while the shrunken figure is pushed to the far right with dead space in between. A also breaks the headline badly as 'MEMORIES, NOT / PRICES.', splitting the phrase after the comma. B breaks it naturally at the comma across two strong lines, though 'MEMORIES,' runs uncomfortably close to the figure's bag.
